name: submit_pto_request
description: submit_pto_request: Submit a PTO request for a date range. Deducts the appropriate number of days from the employee's balance. Returns a case_id and the exact days deducted.

employee_id.description: The employee's ID. Format: EMP followed by 6 digits. Example: EMP048271

pto_type.description: The type of PTO: pto (general paid time off) or sick (sick leave)

start_date.description: The first day of requested time off in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-05-07

end_date.description: The last day of requested time off in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: 2026-05-13
